records: ERRATUM: The 2026-10-30T145000Z snapshot's 309,389.79 XRP combined source-wallet residual was incorrect. The 302K and 7,361 XRP values for rarG... and rNU4... were child-account activation amounts, not top-level current balances. Fresh Bithomp pages show 8.60 XRP for each of the four non-rDAE source accounts and 11.59 XRP for rDAE, totaling 45.99 XRP. The earlier snapshot is preserved but superseded; do not reuse its residual figure.

Bithomp's current account pages are dynamic explorer displays and not a signed Binance PoR proof. They establish page-observed balances and labels, not official reserve-wallet membership, customer liabilities or tradable float.
